subagents_max_concurrent.label: Max Concurrent Subagents
subagents_max_concurrent.help: Maximum number of simultaneously active subagents, default 20, range 1~20.

subagents_token_budget.label: Token Budget
subagents_token_budget.help: Context token budget per subagent step call. Default 200000.

subagents_api_timeout_secs.label: API Timeout
subagents_api_timeout_secs.help: Timeout for subagent single-step model calls, default 120s, range 1~1800.

subagents_heartbeat_timeout_secs.label: Heartbeat Timeout
subagents_heartbeat_timeout_secs.help: How long a subagent can be unresponsive before being considered dead and cleaned up, default 300s, range 30~3600, must be greater than api_timeout_secs.

subagents_default_model.label: Default Subagent Model
subagents_default_model.help: Fallback model when no role is specified.

max_depth.label: Max Depth
max_depth.help: Maximum hierarchical depth that subagents can recursively delegate to other subagents.

launch_concurrency.label: Launch Concurrency
launch_concurrency.help: How many subagents to launch simultaneously in one turn before queuing the rest. Prevents instant burst from causing API rate limiting.

max_admitted.label: Max Admitted
max_admitted.help: Total number of subagents including running and queued. High fan-out tasks can be queued, but runtime launch pressure is controlled.

worker_model.label: Worker Model
worker_model.help: Subagent model for executing specific coding/modification tasks.

explorer_model.label: Explorer Model
explorer_model.help: Subagent model for exploring codebase and searching files.

awaiter_model.label: Awaiter Model
awaiter_model.help: Subagent model for waiting for external events and polling results.

review_model.label: Review Model
review_model.help: Subagent model for code review and result verification.
